Cache::lock guards cross-host (V2 LB), lockForUpdate guards same-host pool, DB UNIQUE catches both fail. Empirical NF525 chain unchanged after Wave Polish Final stress (50 orders / 3 concurrency).

scenarios.scenario: Borne process crash (Vue SPA bug, browser hard crash)
scenarios.blast_radius: Single physical borne. Other bornes unaffected (each borne = independent SPA + own kiosk-token).
scenarios.recovery: Auto-login on reboot (foodkingConfig.kioskAutoLogin if IP-allowlisted), or kiosk-login via username/password fallback (KIOSK_REQUIRE_MACHINE_LOGIN UI form available).
scenarios.data_loss: In-progress cart only (Vuex state). Submitted orders are server-side persisted; idempotency key prevents double-submit on retry.

scenarios.scenario: Borne network drop during cart -> payment flow
scenarios.recovery: Offline queue (kiosk-app shows kiosk-offline-indicator + kiosk-abandoned-indicator escalation if multiple failures). KioskOfflineConflictModal handles divergence. Idempotency 24h TTL ensures retry on reconnect doesn't double-charge.

scenarios.scenario: Borne payment terminal (TPE) hardware fail mid-charge
scenarios.blast_radius: Single transaction stuck in PENDING + UNPAID OR PAID + PENDING (if Stripe webhook arrived but browser died).
scenarios.recovery: CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders (15min TTL) auto-rejects UNPAID. stripe:drain-stranded-cpn (every 5min) flushes stranded PAID-but-PENDING. Customer notified via SendOrderMail + SMS + Push.

scenarios.blast_radius: ALL bornes + KDS + OSS + POS (single Le Cayenne node = single-point-of-failure in V1 LOCAL).
scenarios.recovery: Manual: POS staff falls back to paper. Backups: daily 03:00 + monthly + quarterly (6y retention).
scenarios.v1_acceptance: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box file driver IS the documented architecture (UNI-03 deferred to cloud cutover). Owner accepts SPOF in exchange for zero cloud cost + zero latency.
scenarios.rto_minutes: depends on root cause; backup restore drill is PASS per Wave Polish Final

scenarios.scenario: Borne fiscal_sequence_no gap (worst case for NF525 audit)
scenarios.likelihood: VERY LOW — Cache::lock + lockForUpdate + DB UNIQUE triple-defense
scenarios.fallback: If alloc fails -> order stays PENDING (status not promoted) + fiscal_alloc_error_at flag set OUTSIDE tx (Wave M heal) + foodking:fiscal:retry-alloc cron (every minute) retries until success. Audit chain verifier (fiscal:verify-chain, daily 03:30) catches drift PER BRANCH (Wave 3b FISCAL-ADV3B-01).

peak_load_protection.rate_limit_kiosk_orders: config('kiosk.order_rate_limit', 5) per minute per (user|ip) — prevents accidental spam-submit but generous enough for genuine customer retries
peak_load_protection.rate_limit_kiosk_login: 30/min by username|ip (iter15 D-001) — preserves machine relogin headroom
